lines.text: Well, Seymour, I made it, despite your directions.
I hope you're prepared for an unforgettable luncheon.
Oh, egads! My roast is ruined!
I were to purchase fast food and disguise it as my own cooking?
The superintendent's gonna need his medication
When he hears Skinner's lame exaggerations
There'll be trouble in town tonight
I was just, uh, just stretching my calves on the windowsill.
Isometric exercise! Care to join me?
Why is there smoke coming out of your oven, Seymour?
That isn't smoke, it's steam! Steam from the steamed clams we're having.
Superintendent, I hope you're ready for mouthwatering hamburgers!
I thought we were having steamed clams.
Oh, no, I said steamed hams.
Well, I'm from Utica, and I've never heard anyone use the phrase steamed hams.
Oh, not in Utica, no. It's an Albany expression.
You know, these hamburgers are quite similar to the ones they have at Krusty Burger.
Oh ho ho ho, no! Patented Skinner Burgers. Old family recipe!
Yes, and you call them steamed hams despite the fact that they are obviously grilled.
Well, that was wonderful. A good time was had by all. I'm pooped.
Yes, I should be, good Lord, what is happening in there?
At this time of year, at this time of day, in this part of the country, localized entirely within your kitchen?
No, mother, it's just the northern lights.
Well, Seymour, you are an odd fellow, but I must say
